name: Claude Code · Sonnet 5.5
prompt:
Make an event-replay data animation of the Silicon Valley Bank collapse in March 2023 — what happened in those 48 hours. The data must be real, with sources.

Requirements:
- Vertical 1080×1920, 30 fps, 25–40 seconds
- Music and sound effects; export one mp4 with audio to the current directory

after.note: The agent started the render in the background and ended its turn; the headless session ended and took the render with it. The video was rendered afterwards from the agent's own page with its own render.py, unchanged.
